Donald Trump’s approval numbers have hit their lowest point among registered Alabama voters since the beginning of his second presidential term.

According to online polling from Civiqs as of Sept. 2, 48 percent of Alabama respondents approve of the way Trump is handling his job, a decline from 59 percent approval he had when he returned to the White House in January 2025.
